verdict.rationale: Poly has an editing surface with optional Vim keybindings, which supports keyboard-driven editing. Journal entries are Markdown files, and journaling lets you attach files. That implies basic formatting and some media attachment, but none of the specific note-formatting features are documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of headings, callouts, tables, code blocks and inline embedded media in the editor; evidence of editor speed; independent or hands-on corroboration.
